_note: MONITORING + DRAIN-ECONOMICS POLICY. Controls the usage history store (bin/usage-record.py), orchestration-event observability (bin/observe.py; privacy-safe, never authority), retention (user-controlled, default 1 year), the reserve sizing defaults, the cost policy (maximize subscription tokens, minimize API $), probe-only external source commands, and window auto-learning. Nothing here is per-account layout — it is policy that scales to any number of subscriptions.
retention_note: History older than this is pruned by bin/usage-record.py --prune (or on each --snapshot). Set to 0 to keep forever (not recommended — infinite log growth). This is the user's control over how long usage data is kept.

observability.note: Append-only routing-quality telemetry. Never grants authority, never logs prompts/task bodies/diffs/credentials/customer data/absolute user paths. Write failure does not change a routing decision. Actor ids are explicit pseudonyms (or profile:<name>); identity is never inferred from USER/HOME/git. Runtime log is gitignored; synthetic fixtures are committed under model-evals/fixtures/observability/.

reserve_defaults.note: Reserve for an intake/dispatch seat = observed dispatch consumption over a window × margin_factor, floored at intake_reserve_pct. A reserve NEVER prevents coding — it only lowers priority (never-strand): if every worker seat is spent, the intake seat codes. bin/drain-plan.py --reserve computes a live recommendation from history.

cost_policy.note: Maximize subscription (included) token usage; drain metered $ seats (Cursor Other Models, Review E) LAST — only when no included capacity remains. This maximizes subscription value and minimizes API billing.

owner-manual.note: owner-entered % from provider dashboards: bin/usage-record.py --owner seat=pct

teamclaude.note: Probe-only JSON parse on the worker Mini; persists zero history rows until a schema-bound seat adapter is implemented (KarpelesLab/teamclaude).

ccusage.note: Probe-only JSON parse; persists zero history rows until a schema-bound seat adapter is implemented (ryoppippi/ccusage).

window_learning.note: bin/usage-record.py --learn-windows infers a reset anchor from an observed spent→available transition and writes data/observed-windows.json; usage-status uses an observed anchor when the configured anchor is null. It NEVER overwrites an owner-set anchor. This keeps refresh windows auto-updating instead of stale.

scheduling.note: Pick a seat with enough runway (time-to-reset) to finish the current task; bring a just-reset account in at the NEXT task boundary, never mid-turn. resolve-route --task-seconds N flags seats that would reset before N elapses.
